topics.text: The hotel maintains high standards of cleanliness across rooms, bathrooms, and communal areas. Regular upkeep of facilities like the swimming pool and landscaped courtyards contributes to a pleasant stay, with no major complaints about hygiene or maintenance issues.

The property is easily reachable with ample parking available. Its central location allows quick access to Yucun’s shopping, dining, and cultural hubs, while still offering a tranquil retreat away from urban noise.

address: No. 24, Wangjia, Liaoyuan Village, Moganshan Town, Deqing, Zhejiang, China

comments.quote: It is a clean hotel with spacious rooms. The view from the rooms is one of the key advantages. It’s a bit away from all the bars and restaurants, so it’s more quiet. Can definitely recommend.
comments.author: Guest User

comments.quote: Lovely, cozy hotel with exceptionally friendly staff. The room was clean and offered a beautiful view. Thank you!
comments.author: Alina Danylets

comments.quote: Excellent value for money, clean and very comfortable rooms. Convenient parking, close to Yucun center. The landlady is also very helpful.
